content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. Research shows that sets taken close to failure (about 0-3 reps left in the tank) build similar muscle across a wide range, roughly 5-30 reps. Lighter loads just need more reps and more fatigue to get there. 💪

Your 100 kg bench goal is different. Strength is specific, so you'll need to practice heavy singles, triples and fives to hit that number. The best plan is mostly moderate reps (6-12) for size, plus heavy sets on the bench to build the strength. Ain't nothin' but a peanut! 🏋️
